items.title: Ed Garland Interview, 1958-08-08; 1958-09-03
items.q: A fella named Frank played clarinet. Frank Lewis... All right, old Connish played trombone... Jimmy Johnson played bass... James Phillips played drums.

ctx.x: Buddy Bowling, trumpet. A fella named Frank played clarinet. Frank Lewis. Frank Lewis. Frank Lewis. All right, old Connish played trombone. Willie Connish played trombone. Jimmy Johnson played bass. James Phillips played drums. James Phillips. Yeah, he was out of his mouth in his mouth all the time. Two thing that, he'd go to sleep, get on the bandstand, wouldn't be there, and ten minutes before he'd go to bed. All the time. All the time.
And his name was Lewis? No, Jimmy Phillips.
